spl_product_data_elements: CITRACID-50 Desinfectant Solution for Hemodialysis Machine WATER CITRIC ACID MONOHYDRATE ANHYDROUS CITRIC ACID
spl_unclassified_section: This product is used to descale and desinfect Hemodialysis machines.
purpose: For use with 3-pump hemodialysis machines only.
indications_and_usage: For use with 3-pump hemodialysisi machines only, using purified water (StandardUNE-EN ISO 23500-3:2019).
warnings: Avoid contact with skin an eyes. Irritation hazard if spilled or splashed.
do_not_use: If the warranty seal is damaged or broken and do not allow debris to fall into the concentrate.
when_using: Take appropriate security measures (protective clothing, glasses, masks). Wash splashes on skin or clothing with plenty of water.
stop_use: If do not use the entire contents, discard the excess.
keep_out_of_reach_of_children: Keep out of reach of children. If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away.
dosage_and_administration: By diluting one part of this acid concentrate with one part of purified water.
storage_and_handling: Store at room temperature. Keep container tightly closed when not in use.
